links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to zirconia crown FAQs, measured by Flesch Reading Ease Score
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-5 and DeepSeek showed superior readability; Microsoft Copilot scored lowest, particularly for readability. No numeric FRES values reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Gemini achieved the highest scores in accuracy, quality, and reliability (p < 0.001), while ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-5, and DeepSeek demonstrated superior readability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, readability, and reliability of several commercial LLMs on patient-facing dental FAQs in an offline simulated test without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
